name: anivaryam-tools
description: Claude Code plugins for the anivaryam tool family: proc-compose, merge-port, tunnel, env-vault. Each plugin bundles a skill (usage knowledge), slash commands (CLI wrappers), a SessionStart hook (config detection), and a diagnostic subagent.

plugins.name: proc-compose
plugins.description: Local process orchestrator. One YAML, one lifecycle, one log stream. Frontend+backend dev stacks, microservices, container entrypoints.

plugins.name: merge-port
plugins.description: Local reverse proxy. Merge client and server onto one port. Path-prefix or route mode, WebSocket passthrough.

plugins.name: tunnel
plugins.description: Self-hosted ngrok alternative. Expose localhost through a relay you control. HTTP/TCP/UDP, named tunnels, daemon mode.

plugins.name: env-vault
plugins.description: Encrypted .env file manager. Seal secrets into committable vault files (AEAD + Argon2id).
